notes.title: Lust Mansion 🔞 is ready to be investigated - solve the inheritance mystery!
notes.notes:
What would you do if you were Peter? If you got a whole mansion and a load of money as an inheritance from your step-grandfather? If you'd also known that he died in a strange way and much sooner than the doctors would have predicted? And if you know that there's something off and things aren't that clear? You would try to make sense of the situation, of course! Otherwise, you might face a similar fate, since those who began the thing certainly won't leave it unfinished.Find your way through all the hard choices, complicated mysteries, versatile characters and a bunch of immensely hot adult 18+ content - and to those first on the road comes something special - a few free keys, of course!

notes.title: Lust Mansion 🔞 is nearing its release - all the secrets will be revealed soon
notes.notes:
This adult visual novel will take you through an investigation of your own - take control of Peter, who got a family mansion of his step-grandfather inherited and get to know what mysteries it hides about the real cause of his death and what people Peter knows for a long time may have to do with it. Take your time to find the balance between trying to manage your plans for the inheritance you've got and trying to solve the mysterious circumstances that led to all of this. Lust Mansion will take you on an intriguing trip, full of lust, enigma and multifaceted characters - don't get lost and make it all work out!

Don't be late for the release if you'd like to grab a little bonus 😉
